name: trackiq-amazon-search-term-harvester
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Search-Term Harvester
summary: Finds the Amazon search terms that already convert above break-even but have no keyword of their own, and turns them into an upload-ready Sponsored Products bulk file with exact-match keywords and suggested bids. Checks every candidate against the existing targets so nothing is proposed twice.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.
